items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: I say myself and Amy are the only really classically trained in the band.

ctx.x: Are most of the people in your band, are they — I hate to use the word — but are they college-trained musicians and schooled?

Some. Just, well actually one. Amy, the keyboard player. She went to a classical school in North Carolina. Both Aaron and Nikki both went to Berklee but Aaron is self-taught as a bass player, and Nicky grew up like in churches so she was like — I say myself and Amy are the only really classically trained in the band.
They probably all — it’s probably hard to get everybody’s schedule coordinated and say okay when are you free.
